functions.name: attaching letter, no incoming and no outgoing connection
attaching letter, incoming and outgoing connection

rules.text: membership in the six-letter non-attaching set is a closed lexical fact about the letter itself, never inferred from shape resemblance; every other letter of the inventory attaches forward when a following letter is declared present
a non-attaching letter never sends an outgoing connection to what follows it, regardless of what that neighbor is, so it realizes only the final or the standalone shape

an attaching letter's incoming connection depends on whether the declared preceding neighbor is itself capable of sending an outgoing connection (word start or a non-attaching predecessor both block it); its outgoing connection depends only on whether a following letter is declared present

the hamza-bearing and bare variants of the alif member are one member of the non-attaching set; a hamza-bearing variant of a different letter is not folded into that letter's class without its own licensed row
this table classifies one letter's joining behaviour only; a classification, and any run boundary it might suggest, is never promoted to a token, morpheme, root, entry, or sense boundary
